selection: All bursty_input/stalled_input/cpu_contention traces in apps6/9/10; fixed deployment-visible apps selected prospectively for three-type, three-app coverage. All events retained in manifest with reasons. Normal: four smallest single ZIP archives per app (size, numeric ID tie), then numeric ID order assigns fit/validation/calibration/control.

pca.fit: all finite observed fit points; mean/std fit-only; deterministic float64 SVD

lstm.checkpoint: final epoch only; no early stopping/model selection

baseline_C: NOT_RUN_PRESEALED: DIVAD pinned TranAD custom TransformerEncoderLayer.forward lacks is_causal; DecoderLayer lacks tgt_is_causal/memory_is_causal required by available Torch2.9 wrappers. Native old framework parity or compatibility overlay not sealed. No fancy replacement; A+B meets two distinct family requirement.
features: Exathlon official19-feature bundle definitions with separately declared causal preprocessing; no feature/model/type selection from detector outcomes

preprocessing.duplicates: first row at same timestamp in source order; no sorting to hide nonmonotonic input
preprocessing.timestamps: strict integer native epoch1s; missing times inserted only as causal history, primary target must be observed
preprocessing.sentinel: -1 and nonfinite per input become missing; causal ffill limit5 observations on full grid; no initial fill
preprocessing.executor_average: same-time mean of raw active slots before fill; inactive -1 excluded; resulting mean causal ffill limit5 then backward difference
preprocessing.derivative: backward one-step difference at target; first/invalid difference unavailable
preprocessing.scaler: global mean/population std from finite observed fit rows only; zero std ->1; no clipping/test normalization
preprocessing.window: LSTM history[t-32,t-1], target t observed; all history/input finite; no cross-trace state

threshold.source: whole-trace normal calibration; global primary, app-normal secondary only; no test labels

phase.overlap: all other known/unknown annotated supports excluded; ambiguous delay censored
phase.effect_only: complete expected native RCI scores required, no eligible RCI alarm AND >=1 EEI alarm; gaps -> N/A
phase.delay: complete native RCI/EEI support and no ambiguous overlap; else N/A
phase.primary_excluded: point RCI,unknown,no_application_impact,application_crash,bursty_input_crash,absent EEI; excluded events remain secondary

controls.stationary: duration-matched RCI and EEI plus300s pre from independent heldout normal traces;10 equally spaced windows per trace/event if feasible, deduplicate starts; no result-informed matching
controls.pre_event: same-duration pseudo RCI/EEI ending301s before true RCI; reject other event contamination; never called undisturbed truth
controls.no_impact: native RCI plus60s post-end pseudo effect; NOT ground-truth EEI; descriptive negative control only
controls.crash: censoring audit only; no primary contribution

material.rationale: One full normal IQR is a prespecified substantial within-event phase shift rather than a tiny positive sign; normal contrast<=0.5 and excess>=1 reject similar normal ramps.10 percentage-point excess alarms prevents isolated q.995 chance positives. Engineering falsification margins, not literature guarantees.

gate_rules.execution: any identity/leakage/runtime/availability invariant fails -> stop, amendment before changed execution
gate_rules.resolution: either family raw eligible primary events<50%, <2 types/<3 apps or matched controls<5 for majority -> insufficient
gate_rules.no_gap: Neither family reaches1IQR OR both reach pooled margin but type/app directions fail OR control corroboration fails without measured context offset -> NO_ROOT_EFFECT_GAP for a stable shared panel mechanism, not zero difference in every event.
gate_rules.model_specific: only one family passes raw material contrast -> MODEL_SPECIFIC_ONLY
gate_rules.context: Both raw contrasts pass but same-duration stationary normal ramp>=0.5IQR or normal-excess contrast<1IQR AND event pre-normal baseline differs by>=2IQR in both families -> CONTEXT_SHIFT_DOMINANT, descriptive confounding under unmatched context, not causal dominance proof.
gate_rules.threshold_only: both raw medians<1 and effect-only excess>=0.1 -> THRESHOLD_ARTIFACT_ONLY; this check precedes NO_ROOT_EFFECT_GAP
gate_rules.supported: both families median Delta>=1, each type/app median>0 across>=2types/3apps, excess-normal Delta>=1, stationary controls median<0.5, effect-only excess>=0.1 with >=50% events complete alarm support, crash/noimpact excluded, residual distinguishes native generic AD3 result. Supports mechanism only, no novelty/method GO

limitations: Small fixed global19-feature panel and single seed; event dependencies retained by trace/app. No iid p-values, no full benchmark, no native LSTM reproduction. No after-result rescue.
protocol_bug: STOP; amendment commit+push and exposure disclosure before resuming; no silent rerun
